chapters.title: DFS right-first, first node per depth
chapters.code:
def right_side_view(root):
    view = []

    def dfs(node, depth):
        if node is None:
            return
        if depth == len(view):            # first visit to this depth
            view.append(node.val)
        dfs(node.right, depth + 1)        # right first
        dfs(node.left, depth + 1)

    dfs(root, 0)
    return view
